notes: Buck Street jogs at Harrison: the 50' part south of Harrison is centred ~315 px west of the 40' part north of Harrison (two T points). Lowry Street is a market-space street like Elder at Findlay Market: a long island block labelled MARKET SPACE / STONE YARD (labelled LOWRY on sheet 222) runs from Western to Barnard, with a ~33 ft roadway on each side. The north roadway carries the LOWRY label and is recorded as Lowry Street; the south roadway (between the island and the grocery/storage-shed block) has no name and is recorded as '?'. McRoberts Street (from sheet 222) meets Western's SW side ~450 px NW of the Lowry north roadway, so the two are separate T junctions, not a crossing. Buck meets Barnard opposite the market island, between the two Lowry roadway mouths. The '?' crossing Ernst Alley is an unnamed 10 ft alley running from Harrison south to Barnard (listed under alleys; it leans ~1 deg like the whole page). A second unnamed 10 ft alley runs through block 2 from Barnard to Buck (listed under alleys). McLean Avenue: the north part is ~93 ft wide as drawn, so the centre was taken midway between its building lines (the water pipe is ~20-30 px east of that); it continues north of Harrison between block lines at x~5465 and ~6210 (wider than the street south of Harrison) and that part is not named on this sheet. Division Street (~42 ft, no width printed) is the strip between the triangle block (west line x~6105) and the McLean east line at the binding, centre ~6233; since it forks off the east side of the McLean bend and its centreline never meets the McLean centreline, the bend point is used for Division/McLean. Barnard runs into the open area at the McLean bend; its centreline meets the SSW part of McLean at (5909,5930). Western Avenue meets McLean at the south tip of block 4 (2110/2113); the part SE of McLean is cut off by the bottom edge here, but sheet 224 shows Western continuing SE of McLean to Bank, so Western/McLean is a cross. Circled numbers (58', 62', 65', 72') are grade marks, not widths.
